senses.gloss: pr. n. m.Abbahu, name of two Palestine Amoraim, one prob. of the first gener.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:1:5">Y. Ber. V, 8ᵈ</cite> bot; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 2:1:9">Y. Bicc. II, 64ᵈ</cite> top; the second a celebrated disciple of R. Yoḥannan, residing in Cæsarea.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:1:13">Y. Ber. II, 4ᵇ</cite> top.
Succ. 48ᵇ; a. fr.—Babylonian Amoraim by that name.
<cite ref="Shabbat 119b:7">Sabb. 119ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Kiddushin 33b:16">Kidd. 33ᵇ</cite>, father of Rabbah, v. <cite ref="T00060"><he>רַבָּה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 117b:4">B. Kam. 117ᵇ</cite>, contemp. of R. Ashé, v. <cite ref="A03283"><he>אַשֵׁי</he></cite>.
